d: Migrant workers in Surat Gujarat factories create expensive designer lehengas worth lakhs of rupees yet live in cramped 5000 rupee rooms with broken roofs that flood during rain, no clean drinking water, poor toilet facilities especially for women, narrow dangerous lanes and stairs, open electrical wires, and dilapidated buildings that pose serious safety risks. Many underage children as young as 13 also live and work in these harsh conditions. The KhabarGaon team visited these laborers, listened to their struggles, and documented the daily hardships they endure while producing high-value…
